import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_foodborne_illness_cost_by_pathogen.xlsx', sheet_name='MeanTotalAndPerCaseCosts', header=None)

result = float(salmonella_row['Mean total cost (millions)'])
if result.is_integer():
    result = int(result)

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_foodborne_illness_cost_by_pathogen.xlsx', sheet_name='MeanTotalAndPerCaseCosts', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.apply(lambda r: r.astype(str).str.contains('Pathogen classification').any(), axis=1)].index[0]
df.columns = [str(col).strip() for col in df.iloc[header_idx]]
df = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].reset_index(drop=True)

pathogens = df[df['Pathogen classification'].isin(['Bacteria', 'Parasites', 'Viruses'])].copy()
pathogens['Mean per-case cost'] = pd.to_numeric(pathogens['Mean per-case cost'])
result = pathogens.sort_values(by='Mean per-case cost', ascending=False).iloc[0]['Pathogen']

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_foodborne_illness_cost_by_pathogen.xlsx', sheet_name='MeanTotalAndPerCaseCosts', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.apply(lambda r: r.astype(str).str.contains('Pathogen classification').any(), axis=1)].index[0]
df.columns = [str(col).strip() for col in df.iloc[header_idx]]
df = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].reset_index(drop=True)

campy_cases = pd.to_numeric(df[df['Pathogen'].astype(str).str.contains('Campylobacter', case=False)]['Mean number of cases']).iloc[0]
salm_cases = pd.to_numeric(df[df['Pathogen'].astype(str).str.contains('nontyphoidal', case=False)]['Mean number of cases']).iloc[0]
result = 'yes' if campy_cases > salm_cases else 'no'
